Start date: 1793-09-23  
Add 46 weeks = 322 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 324 days.  
1793 is not a leap year (1792 was leap, 1796 next leap).  
From Sep 23, 1793:  
Days left in Sep 1793: 7  
Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → 7+31+30+31 = 99 days to end of 1793.  
324 − 99 = 225 days into 1794.  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days.  
225 − 181 = 44 days into July 1794.  
July has 31 days, so 44 days into July = July 44? That’s wrong — check subtraction:  

Actually:  
Days into 1794 after adding 324 days from 1793-09-23:  
Remaining 1793: Sep 7, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 = 99 days.  
324 − 99 = 225 days into 1794.  

1794 is not leap year.  
Jan 31 (225−31=194), Feb 28 (194−28=166), Mar 31 (166−31=135), Apr 30 (135−30=105), May 31 (105−31=74), Jun 30 (74−30=44), Jul 31 (44−31=13).  
So after July 31, we have 13 days left → August 13, 1794.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-08-13
